targets.expr: (sum by(uri,method)(((rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{customer="$customer",environment="$environment",role=~"app|reader|data|standby|probe|host",job="exchange-api",uri!~"/actuator(/.*)?",status=~"429"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(instance,job) ((up{customer="$customer",environment="$environment",role=~"app|reader|data|standby|probe|host",job="exchange-api"} and (time() - timestamp(up{customer="$customer",environment="$environment",role=~"app|reader|data|standby|probe|host",job="exchange-api"}) < 90)) == 1)))) or (0 * sum by(uri,method)(((rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{customer="$customer",environment="$environment",role=~"app|reader|data|standby|probe|host",job="exchange-api",uri!~"/actuator(/.*)?"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(instance,job) ((up{customer="$customer",environment="$environment",role=~"app|reader|data|standby|probe|host",job="exchange-api"} and (time() - timestamp(up{customer="$customer",environment="$environment",role=~"app|reader|data|standby|probe|host",job="exchange-api"}) < 90)) == 1))))
